# Test fixtures

`healthy.ttf` is "Fixture Sans", a small synthetic font generated by everythingfonts.com
(the Everything Fonts site repository, `tools/scripts/fonttools/make_fixture_fonts.py`).
It contains no third-party glyph data. Its name table declares it a synthetic test font in the
public domain (name IDs 0 and 13). The smoke workflow checks it.
